checks.name: No medium preserves HDR RGB exactly
Zero distance gives T=1 and S=0
Segment solution agrees with independent Simpson quadrature
Adjacent segments compose to the unsplit transfer solution
Zero extinction has a finite linear source limit
Optically thin limit avoids subtractive cancellation
Optically thick transfer remains finite and bounded
Humidity cannot invent aerosol at zero dry concentration
Dry particles retain unit hygroscopic radius and area
Sub-saturated RH grows existing particles monotonically
Kappa water-volume relation and area proxy are explicit
Shared sky normalization exactly reconstructs wet Mie
Non-hygroscopic particles do not grow with RH
Saturation input is bounded instead of producing infinite fog
Scattering albedo is bounded by extinction
Rayleigh blue extinction exceeds green and red
Rayleigh and HG phase functions conserve angular normalization
